rows.name: Hawaii Medical Board
rows.mandate: Licenses and disciplines Hawaii's physicians and osteopathic physicians. Eleven members appointed by the Governor — seven physicians, two osteopathic physicians, and two public members, spread across the counties (HRS 453-5).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from the Hawaii Revised Statutes; HI publishes no central board-vacancy list (inventory mode)

rows.name: Hawaii Board of Land and Natural Resources
rows.mandate: Governs Hawaii's public lands, water, forests, aquatic resources, and historic sites. Seven members appointed by the Governor with Senate consent — one per land district and three at large (HRS 171-4).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from the Hawaii Revised Statutes; HI publishes no central board-vacancy list (inventory mode)

rows.name: Hawaii Real Estate Commission
rows.mandate: Licenses and regulates Hawaii's real estate brokers and salespersons. Nine members appointed by the Governor — at least four licensed brokers, two public members, spread across the counties (HRS 467-3).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from the Hawaii Revised Statutes; HI publishes no central board-vacancy list (inventory mode)
